blocks.text: Reference grammar B2

This part collects in tables what you studied in the Level B2 and continue the numbering of the cards A1, A2 and B1 (G1–G60). In B2 the grammar of the sentence is largely complete: the cards relate mainly to text (the long period, attribution, certainty, argumentation, connotation), translation in both directions and variation (fuṣḥā spoken, switched, variety). They do not replace the explanations of units: they are used to review, control a doubt while reading or writing and prepare tests and exams. The reference unit shall be indicated for each card. The G tabs78–G80 They sum up the traces of variety.
G61 · Read an article (B2-01)

The method in four times. 1. Before reading: the thresholds of the text (heading, title, supratitle and subtitle, signature, date, testata, genre) and your hypotheses. 2. Global reading: without stopping, who, what, where, when, who speaks.

3. Analytical reading: period by period, main verb, subject, sources; the dictionary for words only key. 4. After reading: the article file (genus, theme, facts, sources, positions, gaps) and an oral summary of three sentences.

blocks.text: The adjective at the bottom of the chain. Nothing fits into the terms of theiḍāfa: The adjectives all go after the last term. What name do they refer to? Check, in this order: gender and number; determination; case (if there are vowels); sense. ⁧وَزِيرُ خَارِجِيَّةِ الدَّوْلَةِ الجَدِيدُ⁩ : ⁧الجَدِيدُ⁩ is male, so the new minister is. With more adjectives, the closest to his name comes first: ⁧وَزِيرُ الخَارِجِيَّةِ الإِيطَالِيُّ السَّابِقُ⁩ The former Italian Minister of Foreign Affairs. Break the chain with ⁧لِـ⁩ . ⁧الرَّئِيسُ الجَدِيدُ لِلشَّرِكَةِ⁩ The new president of the company is hereby appointed. ⁧الاِجْتِمَاعُ السَّنَوِيُّ لِوُزَرَاءِ المِيَاهِ⁩ The annual meeting of water ministers is held. The press uses it when ambiguity is real. Two first terms. Standard: ⁧مُدِيرُ المَدْرَسَةِ وَمُدَرِّسُوهَا⁩ ; printing: ⁧مُدِيرُ وَمُدَرِّسُو المَدْرَسَةِ⁩ (Recognize).
